document.title: Helios VEX - Stratix 5700 industrial switch (CVE-2021-44228, source not collected)

publisher.name: Helios Industrial Security Lab
publisher.contact_details: Helios Industrial Security Lab, 42 Example Way, Springfield / vex@example.org

revision_history.summary: Source collection failed, so the status stays under_investigation; absence of a Java runtime points to likely_not_affected.

full_product_names.name: Apache Log4j 2.14.1 (candidate entry in the SBOM)

full_product_name.name: Apache Log4j 2.14.1 as a candidate component of Rockwell Automation Stratix 5700 Firmware 15.2(7)E

vulnerabilities.title: Apache Log4j2 JNDI lookup leads to remote code execution (CWE-502)

notes.title: Vulnerability summary
notes.text: The JNDI lookup feature of Log4j2 evaluates user-controlled input inside log messages, so a crafted string can load a remote class and execute code.

notes.title: Basis for the VEX verdict
notes.text: The device firmware could not be obtained, so no source analysis was possible (source_code_available=false) and the official status of CSAFPID-0010 is under_investigation. The semantic estimate and its evidence are recorded in analysis.semantic_estimation. The estimate does not substitute for an official not_affected verdict.

notes.title: Why the source could not be collected
notes.text: Vendor firmware not publicly downloadable; no source distribution for the IOS-based switch image.

semantic_estimation.rationale: The log4j entry reached the SBOM through name similarity alone, and the target is an IOS-based switch with neither a Java runtime nor the storage budget to hold one, so the component is very likely absent rather than merely unreachable. likely_affected is set to none because the precondition itself fails; likely_mitigated stays low because no mitigation is claimed, only absence.

evidence.value: IOS-based switch image carries no JVM
64 MB flash cannot hold a Java stack
vendor declares the product family unaffected

hbom_evidence.relevance: An embedded switch SoC without the memory or storage budget to run a JVM.
64 MB of flash makes it physically impossible to ship a Java stack that includes Log4j2.

threats.details: Were the impact to hold, it would mean remote code execution through the logging path; on this device the runtime itself has not been confirmed to exist.
Listed in CISA KEV, but known exploits do not function against a target with no Java runtime.

remediations.details: The vendor states that Log4j2 is not included in this product family. Until source is obtained, Helios treats that only as estimate evidence.
Keep the management interface inside the control network and block outbound LDAP/RMI to reduce residual risk.
